VC_DC_SENSE n_DC_BUS n_C_DC_sense 0

R_DC n_R_DC_sense 0 100
B_ERR n_err 0 v='V_TARGET - v(n_DC_BUS)'
B_P n_P 0 v='v(n_err) * 0.1'
G_INT 0 n_INT n_err 0 0.002
VC_INT_SENSE n_INT n_C_INT_sense 0

VR_INT_SENSE n_INT n_R_INT_sense 0

VR_MAG_DC_SENSE n_mag_flt n_R_MAG_DC_sense 0
R_MAG_DC n_R_MAG_DC_sense 0 1e+06
B_REF n_ref 0 v='v(n_mag_flt) * v(n_VAC_P, n_VAC_N) / V_PEAK'
VR_REF_SENSE n_ref n_R_REF_sense 0
R_REF n_R_REF_sense 0 1e+06
B_IACT n_iact 0 v='i(VSENSE_AC)'
VR_IACT_SENSE n_iact n_R_IACT_sense 0

R_DC_C n_R_DC_C_sense 0 1e+06
V_TRI_src n_tri 0 PULSE(-10 10 0 5u 5u 0 10u)
VR_TRI_SENSE n_tri n_R_TRI_sense 0
R_TRI n_R_TRI_sense 0 1e+06
B_A_TOP n_duty_A_top 0 v='7.5 * (1 + tanh((v(n_tri) - v(n_ctrl) - 0.2)*100))'
B_B_TOP n_duty_B_top 0 v='7.5 * (1 + tanh((v(n_ctrl) - v(n_tri) - 0.2)*100))'
.ic V(n_DC_BUS)=400 V(n_INT)=29.5 V(n_mag_flt)=29.5

.end

.control
set noaskquit
set nomoremode
set numdgt=9

.endc
